title: remove_control inputSchema
description: Argument shape for remove_control (composition profile, ADR-0031). Removes one control, by id, from a composition document's `controls` collection. Target addressing matches add_control: a composition document (mapPackageId or appPackageId) at the standard level, with the reference implementation's draft-lifecycle spelling (draftId + generation) admitted as x-honua-reference-shape. Removing an unknown controlId is an error, not a no-op. Removing a control leaves any interaction bound to `control:{id}` unresolvable, so an implementation MUST either reject the removal or remove those bindings with it — silently keeping a dangling binding is not conformant. See docs/adr/0031-composition-controls.md.

mapPackageId.description: Target MapPackage composition document. Exactly one of mapPackageId / appPackageId / draftId identifies the target.

appPackageId.description: Target AppPackage composition document. Exactly one of mapPackageId / appPackageId / draftId identifies the target.

draftId.description: x-honua-reference-shape: reference-implementation draft-lifecycle target. Requires generation.

generation.description: x-honua-reference-shape: optimistic-concurrency generation of the draft being mutated; the call fails on generation conflict.

controlId.description: Id of the control to remove.

cascadeInteractions.description: When true, interactions whose on.ref or do.ref is `control:{controlId}` are removed with the control. When false (default), the call fails if any interaction still references it, so a document never silently retains an unresolvable binding.
